source.author: lucan
source.text: Belli pars magna peracta est His, quibus effectum est, ne pugnam tiro paveret: Si modo virtutis stimulis iraeque calore Signa petunt.
source.text_original: Belli pars magna peracta est / His, quibus effectum est, ne pugnam tiro paveret: / Si modo virtutis stimulis iraeque calore / Signa petunt.
source.text_english: A great part of the war has been accomplished by these men, through whom it has been brought about that the recruit does not fear battle: if only they seek the standards, driven by the goads of courage and the heat of anger.

reuse.author: val
reuse.text: sed tibi triste nefas fraternaque turbidus arma rex parat et saevos irarum concipit ignes.
reuse.text_original: sed tibi triste nefas fraternaque turbidus arma / rex parat et saevos irarum concipit ignes.
reuse.text_english: But for you, the king, in troubled fury, is preparing a grim crime and brotherly arms, and is kindling the savage fires of anger.
